Baker.description: Someone who works in the bakery: baker, apprentice or driver. A first name alone is not an identity.

Recipe.description: A house recipe, known by the name on its card.

Teamwork.description: A standing tie between two bakers: one trains the other, or one is the other's relief on a shift.

RecipeCredit.description: Who wrote a recipe and who tested it. Baking from a recipe gives no credit for it.

Order.description: An order of baked goods. taken_by wrote it down, baked_by bakes it, delivered_by drives it out. A wish to order is not an order.

OvenFault.description: A fault found on a piece of equipment. reported_by noticed it, fixer repairs it. fixed stays empty until a repair is recorded.

questions.q: Who wrote the Rye Sourdough recipe?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Recipe)-[:author]->(n1:Baker) WHERE n0.name = 'Rye Sourdough' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Recipe)-[:tester]->(n1:Baker) WHERE n0.name = 'Seeded Batch' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: kwame
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Baker)-[:tested]->(n1:Recipe) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: paloma_r
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Baker)-[:trainer]->(n1:Baker) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: tamsin
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Baker)-[:trainee]->(n1:Baker) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Baker)-[:relief]->(n1:Baker) WHERE n0.name = 'Tamsin Rhydderch' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Has the broken thermostat been fixed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:OvenFault) WHERE n0.fault = 'broken thermostat' RETURN n0.fixed AS fixed

questions.q: Is there a record of the faulty fan being fixed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:OvenFault) WHERE n0.fault = 'faulty fan' RETURN coalesce(n0.fixed, false) AS fixed

questions.q: Who reported the fault on the deck oven?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:OvenFault)-[:reported_by]->(n1:Baker) WHERE n0.oven = 'deck oven' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which orders did Henrike Vos take?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Baker)<-[:taken_by]-(n1:Order) WHERE n0.name = 'Henrike Vos' RETURN n1.item AS item

questions.q: How many rye loaves were ordered?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) WHERE n0.item = 'rye loaves' RETURN n0.quantity AS quantity

questions.q: What item and quantity were baked from the Cardamom Bun recipe?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Recipe)<-[:recipe]-(n1:Order) WHERE n0.name = 'Cardamom Bun' RETURN n1.item AS item, n1.quantity AS quantity

questions.q: What quantities were ordered for the loaves?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) WHERE n0.item CONTAINS 'loaves' RETURN n0.quantity AS quantity

questions.q: Were the seeded loaves gluten free?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) WHERE n0.item = 'seeded loaves' RETURN n0.gluten_free AS gluten_free

questions.q: Is there a record that the treacle tarts are gluten free?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) WHERE n0.item = 'treacle tarts' RETURN coalesce(n0.gluten_free, false) AS gluten_free

questions.q: What fault did Tamsin Rhydderch report?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Baker)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:OvenFault) WHERE n0.name = 'Tamsin Rhydderch' RETURN n1.fault AS fault
